text: むしの　せなかに　はえているのは　とうちゅうかそう　という　キノコ。
note: とうちゅうかそう (冬虫夏草, "winter insect, summer grass") is a real fungus that grows out of the bodies of insect larvae. It is prized in traditional Chinese medicine.
claim: Tochukaso (冬虫夏草, caterpillar fungus) is a real parasitic fungus that grows from insect larvae and is used in traditional Chinese medicine.

check.quote: It parasitizes larvae of ghost moths and produces a fruiting body which is valued in traditional Chinese medicine.
